messages:
support_triage: ACME reported a major issue — their integration called applyStoreCredit but our system executed a refund (issueRefund). Customer lost funds, P0.

maria: omg. any logs or a repro? need request_id and sdk version.

support_triage: request_id=rc_x1z, SDK v2.4.1. minimal request below. thread_ts 1907019000.

support_triage: ```
POST /v1/infer
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-llm-2\",
  \"input\": \"resolve_payment(user_action)\",
  \"tools\": [
    {\"name\":\"issueRefund\",\"signature\":{\"amount_cents\":\"int\",\"currency\":\"str\",\"reason\":\"str\"}},
    {\"name\":\"applyStoreCredit\",\"signature\":{\"amount_cents\":\"int\",\"currency\":\"str\",\"note\":\"str\"}}
  ],
  \"tool_call\": {\"name\":\"applyStoreCredit\", \"args\":{\"amount_cents\":2500,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"note\":\"promo_may\"}}
}
```

support_triage: runtime logs: 
``
[2026-07-10T16:10:01Z] req=rc_x1z resolver:choose -> explicit_name=applyStoreCredit signature_scores={issueRefund:0.85,applyStoreCredit:0.82} final=issueRefund reason=\"signature_priority\"
[2026-07-10T16:10:01Z] req=rc_x1z tool_exec -> executed=issueRefund args={\"amount_cents\":2500,\"currency\":\"USD\",\"reason\":\"promo_may\"}
``

sam: so the name was explicit but resolver still picked issueRefund. does runtime let model override explicit_name?

lee: runtime runs a disambiguation pass. if signatures are very similar we have a policy that favors best signature match (signature_priority). that was intended to reduce accidental credits.

maria: problem: explicit_name should be honored when provided by SDK. ACME used the SDK properly. finance says 7 refunds processed (~$175).

eng-bot: @eng-runtime tagging runtime-oncall. escalated to p0.

eng-runtime-oncall: grabbing the full debug dump now. need model token output, resolver inputs, and any SDK metadata (prefer_explicit_tool flag if set).

support_triage: model dump snippet attached: 
``
model_hint: {\"tool\":\"issueRefund\",\"confidence\":0.64,\"notes\":\"amount looks like refund\"}
resolver_state: {\"explicit_name\":\"applyStoreCredit\",\"signature_scores\":{\"issueRefund\":0.85,\"applyStoreCredit\":0.82},\"policy\":\"signature_priority\",\"final_choice\":\"issueRefund\"}
```

lee: that confidence isn't high. signature_priority snuck in and overrode explicit_name. opaque decision chain — not good.

sam: reproduction steps for eng-runtime:
1) run SDK v2.4.1 with tool_call.name=applyStoreCredit
2) set resolver policy to signature_priority
3) send same args and confirm chosen tool==issueRefund

eng-runtime-oncall: confirmed repro locally with SDK v2.4.1. policy is global default for payment tools.

jordan: mitigation requests: 1) can we flip for ACME tenant to honor explicit_name ASAP? 2) patch runtime to prefer explicit_name across tenants unless model confidence >0.95?

eng-runtime-oncall: can enable tenant override (honor_explicit_name=true) for ACME in 10-15m. hotfix to change default behavior requires review but we can push rule: explicit_name wins unless model_confidence>=0.95. will roll to us-east-1 first.

maria: finance needs list of affected request_ids between 16:05-16:15 UTC. eng-runtime, can you tag logs or query?

eng-runtime-oncall: adding query tag policy=signature_priority and time-window filter. will produce CSV of req ids and affected users in 30m.

billing: we'll pause outgoing settlement for those operations until we reconcile. please DM the user list.

sam: post-incident engineering items:
- make explicit tool_call.name authoritative by default (config + SDK opt-out)
- add stricter key-matching when signatures overlap (prefer exact key equality over semantic "note" v "reason")
- add unit tests for overlapping payment tool signatures

lee: also consider adding an SDK warning when developer provides tool_call.name but runtime policy could override it. visible at client side.

support_triage: temporary customer instruction: upgrade SDK to >=2.5.0 (has prefer_explicit_tool flag) or set prefer_explicit_tool=true in request. sending ACME the tenant override steps.

maria: will draft comms and incident ticket. thanks all. :thumbsup:

support_triage: closing this thread for now — ACME notified, runtime override applied for their workspace, follow-ups in incident ticket.
